facts.fact_text: The applicants, together with a number of other persons, gathered at around 3 p.m. on 6 March 2012 near the metro station Elmlar Akademiyasi in Baku to protest against the alleged ill-treatment of two persons arrested on allegedly political grounds.
The protest on 6 March 2012 near the metro station Elmlar Akademiyasi in Baku was spontaneous and peaceful.
The attempt by the applicants and other protesters to stage a march towards the Ministry of Internal Affairs was stopped by police officers, who began to disperse the protesters.
The police arrested seventeen protesters, including the applicants, on 6 March 2012.
The attempt by the applicants and other protesters to stage a march towards the Ministry of Internal Affairs was stopped by police officers, who began to disperse the protesters.
The police arrested seventeen protesters, including the applicants, on 6 March 2012.
The seventeen arrested protesters, including the applicants, were taken to the Yasamal District Police Office.
At the Yasamal District Police Office, administrative-offence reports (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) were drawn up in respect of the arrested protesters, including the applicants.
On 6 March 2012, the first applicant was brought before the Yasamal District Court.
The Yasamal District Court convicted the first applicant under Article 296 (minor hooliganism) of the Code of Administrative Offences.
The Yasamal District Court sentenced the first applicant to a fine in the amount of 50 Azerbaijani manats (AZN), approximately 40 euros (EUR) at the material time.

The administrative-offence reports in respect of the second applicant stated that the second applicant had committed an administrative offence under Article 298 (violation of the rules on holding public gatherings) of the Code of Administrative Offences.

The administrative-offence reports in respect of the third applicant stated that the third applicant had committed an administrative offence under Article 298 (violation of the rules on holding public gatherings) of the Code of Administrative Offences.
The police ordered the second applicant to pay a fine in the amount of 10 Azerbaijani manats (AZN), approximately 8 euros (EUR) at the material time.
The police ordered the third applicant to pay a fine in the amount of 10 Azerbaijani manats (AZN), approximately 8 euros (EUR) at the material time.
The second applicant was released after payment of the fine of 10 Azerbaijani manats (AZN).
The third applicant was released after payment of the fine of 10 Azerbaijani manats (AZN).
On 19 March 2012, the applicants lodged a complaint with the Baku Administrative Economic Court against the Yasamal District Police Office.
On 27 July 2012, the Baku Administrative Economic Court dismissed the applicants' complaints as unsubstantiated.
On 13 November 2012, the Baku Court of Appeal dismissed the applicants' appeal.
On 13 November 2012, the Baku Court of Appeal upheld the Baku Administrative Economic Court's judgment of 27 July 2012, finding it justified.
By a decision of 13 March 2013, the Supreme Court dismissed the third applicant's cassation appeal.
By a decision of 13 March 2013, the Supreme Court upheld the Baku Court of Appeal's judgment of 13 November 2012, finding it justified.
